as_told.title: Sarbacher tells Wilbert Smith that saucers are studied under Vannevar Bush

plain: A UFO researcher who goes by the online name UAPGerb talks about the diaries of a man named Silas Newton, from around 1950. According to UAPGerb, the diaries describe Wilbur B. Smith, a Canadian radio engineer who led Canada's first government project on UFOs, being told by a man named Robert Sarbacher that UFOs were a top-secret subject, and the name of Vannevar Bush also comes up. If true, it would mean that by 1950 the subject was already being kept highly secret at senior levels.
